files.local_change: Declare the pipeline archive API: attachPipelineArchive (with a caller configuration that keys the archive), flushPipelineArchive and pipelineCacheStats.

Compile pipelines from the embedded MSL sources (FakEmbeddedShaders.hpp) when no metallib path is given, instead of requiring a prebuilt metallib. Persist created pipelines in an MTLBinaryArchive under a caller-given directory keyed by the embedded shader sources, device, OS and a caller-given configuration string (attachPipelineArchive / flushPipelineArchive / pipelineCacheStats), compiling the listed pipelines' sources and creating them from the archive at attach.
